thread:
julia: Quick thread - need a creative run-of-show for this webinar that feels more workshop-like. Idea: 5-7 min act breaks with interactive polls and a live mini-lab. Thoughts?
sam: Love it. Keep the overall duration to 50m. Suggested flow:
- 00:00-05:00 Welcome + icebreaker poll (what's your top pain: latency/cost/reliability/other)
- 05:00-15:00 15m talk (product + 2 quick benchmarks)
- 15:00-25:00 Live mini-lab: participants run a short prompt eval in browser (we capture responses)
- 25:00-30:00 Act break & quick results + 2 slides on learnings
- 30:00-40:00 Breakout Qs (moderated)
- 40:00-50:00 CTA + resources + feedback poll
omar: Technical note - mini-lab requires low-latency sandbox and CORS config. Ops-bot, can we provision session tokens and an ephemeral sandbox?
ops-bot: workshop-provisioner: ephemeral sandboxes available. Token TTL 2 hours. Ensure rate limits applied.
julia: Great. Can someone draft the poll copy and the mini-lab prompt? I can handle slide templates.
sam: I'll draft two poll questions and the mini-lab prompt by Thurs. Also suggest we add a recorded fallback of the lab steps in case of sandbox issues.
julia: OK locking this run-of-show variant. Rehearsal plan: full tech run + lab test 48h before. Also need to add privacy copy for recording + data capture on registration page.
omar: I'll add a short privacy blurb for the registration page: "Your anonymized responses may be used to improve our product and for research. Opt-out available in settings."
julia: Perfect. Assignments:
- sam: poll & mini-lab prompt by Thurs
- julia: slide templates & registration copy by Fri
- omar: sandbox provisioning & privacy blurb by Fri
- ops-bot: schedule rehearsal 48h prior and provision tokens
Thanks all!
